When a prospect is partway through a non-cancellable agreement, a new placement can only proceed by terminating or absorbing the old obligation: the remaining payments, and often a residual or return exposure on top, are quoted by the existing lessor as a payoff or termination figure, and that amount is then either paid by the customer directly, absorbed by the dealer out of its own margin, or — most commonly — added to the amount financed on the new lease and spread over a new and usually longer term, which makes the new monthly payment look competitive while the customer pays for two machines at once. The operating rule has five parts: obtain the payoff quote in writing from the current lessor, with its expiry date, before promising anything; show the rollover as its own line in the proposal with the amount and exactly where it lands; state its effect on the total of payments and on the term length; never use the phrase that the dealer will pay off the customer's lease without immediately saying who actually pays and how; and run the wait-versus-roll arithmetic openly, so that if allowing the term to run to its natural end is better for the customer, that is said plainly and the account is scheduled rather than closed. A rollover the customer chooses with the numbers in front of them is a legitimate tool; a rollover they discover later is the reason this trade has the reputation it has.

included: obtaining and using a written payoff quote from the incumbent lessor
showing the rollover line, its destination and its effect on total payments and term
the open wait-versus-roll comparison and the willingness to schedule instead of close
excluded: negotiating the customer's existing agreement on their behalf or advising them on its enforceability
internal decisions about how much payoff the dealer will absorb from margin, which is a pricing matter

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a customer dispute, a restated payoff quote, or a review of funded deals showing rollovers that were not itemised in the proposal

pros.claim: A visible rollover line makes the dealer the only vendor in the room whose arithmetic the customer can check, which frequently wins the deal outright
pros.example: a controller comparing two proposals and finding only one that shows the remaining obligation being carried forward

pros.claim: Telling a prospect that waiting is cheaper for them buys a scheduled campaign and a reputation that sells the next three accounts
pros.example: declining a mid-term switch, diarising the notice window, and being the only vendor called when it opens

cons.claim: Disclosure often kills the deal in front of you, because a hidden rollover is what would have made the payment look competitive
cons.example: a prospect who abandons a switch once they see the remaining obligation added to the new term

cons.claim: Payoff quotes expire, change with timing and sometimes exclude return or condition charges, so even an honest number can move
cons.example: a quote that lapses during a board approval cycle and comes back higher after another month of interest and charges

failure_modes: estimating a payoff instead of obtaining it in writing, then repricing after the customer has committed
burying the payoff inside the amount financed with no line item
using the phrase about paying off the customer's lease without explaining who bears it
extending the term specifically to hide the effect of the absorbed amount on the payment
acceptance_tests: a written payoff or termination quote from the incumbent lessor, with its expiry date, is on file before any switching promise is made
the proposal shows the rollover amount as a discrete line, states where it is carried, and shows its effect on the total of payments and the term
the file contains a wait-versus-roll comparison shown to the customer whenever the prospect is mid-term
revisit_triggers: the payoff quote expires or the incumbent lessor restates the figure
the approval cycle lengthens so that the arithmetic must be rebuilt at the new date
the customer's own end-of-term exposure changes, for example after a mid-term upgrade by the incumbent

nodes.definition: Choose the shape of the offer to fit the account rather than the compensation plan. The available shapes are a full managed-print agreement covering a mixed fleet of multifunction devices and desktop printers under one page-based agreement with supplies and service included and a periodic review cycle; a single-device or small-cluster lease with a separate cost-per-page service agreement; an outright purchase with a maintenance agreement, which is common where an entity's rules or budget treatment favour a capital purchase or where a cooperative contract price is available; a short-term rental or placement for a temporary site, a project or a seasonal peak; and seat- or user-based constructs where a customer wants a per-person rather than per-device commercial frame. The selection criteria are the durability of the volume, the customer's appetite for a long non-cancellable obligation, whether they have technology staff who can own devices, budget treatment and whether they must spend capital or operating funds, the number and mix of devices, the entity's procurement rules, and whether they need the flexibility to add or remove devices during the term. The shape also decides who owns consumable logistics and where the annuity actually sits, which is why it cannot be chosen by habit; and where no carried line or shape genuinely fits the account, the honest outcome is to say so rather than to place a mismatch.

included: the catalogue of offer shapes and the criteria that select among them
the effect of shape on flexibility, consumable ownership and where the annuity sits
the decision to decline or partner when nothing carried fits
excluded: the device-level right-sizing and fleet consolidation design itself
the ongoing management of the annuity once placed

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: outcome review shows a shape systematically producing disputes, early terminations or unprofitable accounts in a segment

pros.claim: Matching shape to the customer's constraints removes whole categories of later friction, especially around adding and removing devices
pros.example: choosing a fleet-wide page agreement for a district that opens and closes classrooms each year rather than eleven separate device leases

pros.claim: Offering a purchase route where the entity's rules favour it wins deals a lease-only vendor cannot reach
pros.example: quoting from an existing cooperative award for a city that cannot start a new solicitation this year

cons.claim: The shapes differ sharply in annuity value to the dealer, so selection is under permanent commercial pressure
cons.example: a purchase-plus-maintenance route that serves the customer well while producing far less recurring revenue than a bundled agreement

cons.claim: Flexible shapes are harder to price and to administer, and their flexibility can be quietly clawed back in terms the customer does not read
cons.example: an add-and-remove provision that in practice requires a new term whenever a device is added

failure_modes: defaulting to the shape that pays best regardless of fit
committing a customer with volatile device counts to a rigid per-device structure
offering a managed-print frame to an account whose volume cannot support the review and logistics overhead
quoting a shape the customer's procurement rules cannot accept
acceptance_tests: the selected shape is justified in the file against volume durability, device count and mix, procurement route, technology capacity and budget treatment
where the customer needs flexibility to add or remove devices, the mechanism for doing so and its cost are written into the proposal
revisit_triggers: the account's device count, locations or volume durability change during the cycle
the entity's procurement route or budget treatment changes
a shape repeatedly produces disputes or unprofitable accounts in a segment

nodes.definition: Produce the artifact that carries the offer, with contents fixed by policy so that nothing material is left to an individual representative's discretion. The packet contains: the documented volume basis and any labelled assumption with its true-up mechanism; the device configuration with what each device is for and where the pages that justify it actually are; the commercial structure, naming the lease structure, the term, the number and frequency of payments and what sits inside the payment; the service structure with the black and colour rate basis, the minimum commitment and its volume basis, the overage mechanism, inclusions, exclusions and any escalation; the rollover line where a prior obligation is being carried; the end-of-term options written in plain language with the notice window dates, the delivery method for notice and the return obligations; the total-of-payments and the like-for-like total cost over the stated comparison period; the response and coverage commitments as they will actually be staffed; an explicit list of what is not included; and the one-page term summary the customer keeps and acknowledges. The traceability rule governs everything numeric: each figure comes from the customer's own data, a current written quote from a funder or the manufacturer program, or a stated assumption — and nothing is invented to make the page look complete.

included: the mandatory contents of the proposal packet and the term summary
the traceability rule for every number in the packet
presenting response and coverage commitments only as they will be staffed
excluded: the internal cost build and margin analysis behind the price
post-signature implementation planning, which belongs to the deployment knowledge base

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a customer dispute or an internal audit finds a packet section missing, a number untraceable, or a commitment the service organisation cannot meet

pros.claim: A fixed packet makes the quality of a proposal independent of which representative built it, which is the only scalable way to hold a disclosure standard
pros.example: a new hire's first proposal carrying the same notice-window and overage disclosures as a twenty-year veteran's

pros.claim: Traceable numbers survive procurement review and give the customer something to check rather than something to trust
pros.example: a purchasing officer verifying the page rate basis against the meter report attached to the same packet

cons.claim: A complete packet is longer than a competitor's single-page quote and can lose a buyer who wanted a number today
cons.example: a small office comparing a nine-page proposal against a rival's one-line monthly figure and choosing the shorter document

cons.claim: Fixed contents create work that feels wasteful on small placements and invite quiet shortcuts under quota pressure
cons.example: a representative skipping the comparison section on a single-device deal because it seemed unnecessary

failure_modes: promising a response commitment the service organisation cannot staff
omitting the exclusions list so the first billable call becomes a dispute
presenting a saving as guaranteed rather than as arithmetic conditional on stated volume
issuing a packet whose numbers cannot be traced to data, a written quote or a labelled assumption
acceptance_tests: every issued packet contains each mandated section, and a reviewer can trace each number to customer data, a written quote or a labelled assumption
the end-of-term section states the notice window dates and delivery method in plain language
response and coverage commitments in the packet match what the service organisation has agreed it can staff
revisit_triggers: the volume basis, funder quote or program pricing behind the packet changes before signature
a dispute traces to something the packet said or failed to say
the service organisation's staffed response capability changes

nodes.definition: Handle, at sale time, the obligations that attach to placing imaging equipment into organizations that handle protected information. A modern multifunction device is a networked computer: it holds job images and scanned documents on internal storage, it retains address books, scan destinations and stored credentials, it may hold fax and email configuration, and it sits inside the customer's network. That means a lease, a mid-term swap, a service exchange or an end-of-term return physically removes that storage from the customer's premises, which is precisely the event nobody discusses until it happens. The selling-side work is to raise it before the contract rather than after: ask what categories of information run through the devices — patient records, client files, student records, personnel data, payment card data; identify the obligation class the customer may be under, such as health-information privacy rules, education-records rules, payment-data handling standards, state data-breach and record-disposal laws, and professional or contractual confidentiality duties; establish what the customer requires at removal, whether that is storage sanitization, drive removal and retention by the customer, or documented destruction, and who bears the cost; and determine whether the customer needs a written data-handling or business-associate style agreement with whoever services the equipment. Requirements vary by jurisdiction, entity type and contract and change over time: name the class, direct the customer to their own compliance owner and counsel to verify current rules, and never present a device feature or a certificate as legal compliance.

included: surfacing stored-data and confidentiality exposure during the sale
naming the obligation class and routing verification to the customer's compliance owner
settling the sanitization, drive-retention or destruction expectation and its cost in the documents
excluded: configuring device security features and network hardening, which belongs to deployment
legal advice on whether a customer meets any particular regulatory obligation
using compliance risk as a closing lever, which the conduct rules forbid

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a customer compliance owner, a manufacturer capability change, or a jurisdictional rule change alters what must be settled about stored data at removal

pros.claim: Raising stored data before signature converts the trade's most alarming surprise into a priced, documented line item
pros.example: a clinic agreeing at proposal stage that drives will be retained on site at removal, with the replacement cost shown in the packet

pros.claim: Naming the obligation class and deferring to the customer's compliance owner keeps the dealer credible without pretending to expertise it does not have
pros.example: asking a district's records officer what their retention and disposal policy requires rather than asserting what the law says

cons.claim: The subject frightens buyers and sits one sentence away from becoming a fear lever, which the conduct rules prohibit
cons.example: a representative tempted to imply that the incumbent's devices have already created an exposure

cons.claim: Sanitization and drive-retention obligations add cost and end-of-term complexity that competitors quietly leave out of their quotes
cons.example: a proposal that prices drive retention losing to one that says nothing about what leaves the building

failure_modes: discovering a drive-retention requirement at removal, when the equipment is already on the truck
asserting that a device or feature makes the customer compliant
omitting who pays for sanitization or replacement media from the documents
using a compliance concern to create urgency rather than to inform a decision
acceptance_tests: for any account handling protected information, the file records the information categories, the obligation class named, and the customer's stated removal requirement
the sanitization, retention or destruction expectation and who bears its cost appear in the proposal and in the signed documents
no statement in the file presents a device feature or certificate as legal compliance
revisit_triggers: the customer's compliance owner states a requirement not already captured
a manufacturer changes device storage, encryption or sanitization capability
the customer's obligations change through a new contract, payer requirement or jurisdictional rule

nodes.definition: Understand the mechanism of your own money, because misunderstanding it — or hiding it — is what drives mis-selling in this trade. A single placement can produce margin in several places at once: the spread between the dealer's acquisition cost, itself a function of program tier and any approved special pricing, and the equipment amount financed; the difference between the funder's rate factor and the factor the deal is written at; term length, since a longer term lowers the visible payment while raising the total financed; soft costs, delivery, and any absorbed payoff carried inside the amount financed; the page rates set against the dealer's delivered cost per page; and manufacturer program funds earned against conditions. Representative compensation usually pays on some combination of gross profit, funded amount and service annuity, which creates a predictable and entirely foreseeable pressure toward long terms, high minimum commitments and buried rollovers — naming that pressure is part of the work, not an admission. The guardrails belong in the same unit as the mechanism: margin may legitimately be taken in any of these places, but never in a way that depends on the customer not understanding the structure, and any margin source that could not survive the term summary being read aloud is not a margin source but a future dispute. No rate, factor, page rate or margin percentage is ever stated as a market fact; each is derived per deal and per funder and must be verified against a current written quote before it reaches a customer.

included: the places a placement can earn margin, each described as a mechanism
compensation and quota pressures and the behaviours they predictably produce
the read-aloud guardrail and the verify-against-a-written-quote rule
excluded: any specific factor, page rate, margin percentage or commission figure asserted as fact
realized service margin and cost control on the installed base, which belongs to the economics knowledge base

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a compensation plan change, a funder or program cost change, or a pattern of deal reviews finding structures that cannot be explained aloud

pros.claim: Naming every margin source makes deal review possible, so structures that depend on opacity are caught before they reach a customer
pros.example: a review that spots a term extended past the useful life of the equipment purely to absorb an incumbent payoff

pros.claim: Understanding the mechanism lets a dealer hold price with an explanation instead of discounting under pressure
pros.example: explaining what a shorter term does to the payment rather than cutting the page rate to close

cons.claim: The same knowledge is the toolkit for abuse, and compensation plans reward exactly the abusive version
cons.example: a plan paying on funded amount that makes a longer term with an absorbed payoff the most lucrative structure available

cons.claim: Guardrails cost real margin on real deals, and the loss is visible while the benefit is a dispute that never happens
cons.example: a deal repriced downward after review because a margin source could not be explained aloud to the customer

failure_modes: extending term length primarily to hide an absorbed cost
setting a minimum commitment above evidenced volume because the annuity pays better
quoting a factor or page rate from memory rather than a current written quote
treating a compensation-driven behaviour as a personal failing rather than as a plan defect
acceptance_tests: each deal above the review threshold names its margin sources, and each one can be stated aloud to the customer without changing the deal
every factor, page rate and payoff figure used in a quote traces to a current written quote with a date
term length and minimum commitment are justified by evidence and fit rather than by their effect on compensation
revisit_triggers: the compensation plan or quota structure changes
a funder or manufacturer changes factors, program funds or cost positions
deal reviews start finding the same opaque structure repeatedly

nodes.definition: Close the selling unit with a defined, inspectable handoff rather than with a signature and a hope. The definition of done has eight conditions: the equipment order and the finance documents are signed by a person whose authority has been verified, and for a board, council or congregation the authorizing action is on file; the document set is internally consistent, meaning the device list, term, payment, structure, page rates, minimum commitment and inclusions match across the order, the lease and the service agreement, because funders and customers both read them separately; the plain-language term summary is acknowledged and a copy is with the customer; the volume basis and any assumption and true-up language is attached; credit is approved and every condition — guarantee, advance payments, deposit, shortened term — is documented and was disclosed in writing beforehand; the incumbent payoff quote, where one exists, is on file with its expiry and the rollover is reflected in the documents; the customer's own notice obligation to their outgoing lessor is identified with its dates, and where applicable the customer has been told in writing what they must send, to whom and by when, along with what happens to the outgoing equipment; and the site facts the deployment team will need — locations, access constraints, power and network points, scan destinations, contacts and timing constraints — are captured while the customer is still in the room. This handoff is the boundary of this knowledge base: assessment refinement, installation, integration and service activation belong to the deployment knowledge base, and the ongoing annuity belongs to the economics knowledge base.

included: the eight-condition definition of done for a signed order
cross-document consistency checking and authority verification
capture of the outgoing-equipment and notice obligations and of the site facts deployment needs
excluded: the installation, integration, training and service activation work itself
meter baselining and billing setup on the live account

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: deployment or the funder reports recurring defects in handed-off orders, or a post-signature amendment pattern emerges

pros.claim: An inspectable definition of done stops the two failures that cost most after signature: inconsistent documents and an outgoing lease nobody gave notice on
pros.example: catching that the service agreement's term differs from the lease term before the order leaves the sales desk

pros.claim: Capturing site facts at signature saves the install and gives the deployment team a real starting point instead of a discovery visit
pros.example: recording that the second-floor suite has no service elevator and the network closet needs an escort, before a delivery date is promised

cons.claim: A hard gate delays revenue recognition and creates friction with representatives who consider the deal finished at signature
cons.example: an order held for a week while an authorizing board minute is obtained

cons.claim: The checklist can become ceremonial, ticked without inspection, which is worse than no checklist because it manufactures false assurance
cons.example: a consistency check signed off on a packet whose page rates differ between the order and the service agreement

failure_modes: handing off an order whose documents disagree with each other
leaving the customer's non-renewal notice to the outgoing lessor unassigned to anyone
scheduling delivery before credit conditions and authorizations are complete
capturing no site facts and letting the deployment team rediscover the account
acceptance_tests: the order cannot pass to deployment until every one of the eight conditions is evidenced in the file
a reviewer other than the selling representative confirms cross-document consistency of device list, term, payment, page rates and minimum
the customer's notice obligation to the outgoing lessor is documented with dates and an owner
revisit_triggers: a funder or customer amends documents after signature
deployment reports that handed-off site facts were wrong or missing
a pattern of orders failing the same handoff condition

edges.why_related: segment profiles are built on top of the market's volume direction: each profile exists to say where pages persist and why, against a declining baseline
edges.benefit_of_coupling: targets are chosen on durable page generators rather than on segment folklore

edges.why_related: the census is populated segment by segment, and the profile decides which accounts are worth recording and maintaining at all
added care for an unadvised buyer is an intensification of the disclosure standard: the same term summary, delivered earlier, explained slower and checked for comprehension
the same doctrine that governs what a customer must be told about their own agreement governs what may be said about somebody else's
which structures and funders are available, and what the equipment costs before a factor is applied, come from the program model the dealer operates under
funder selection and the submission package only make sense once the structure and the amount financed are settled
what happens at the end of term is produced by the structure chosen at the beginning, so end-of-term mechanics are read off the instrument
the service agreement is quoted alongside the lease and its term, bundling and escalation choices only make sense against the lease structure
the page-based layer is the largest and most variable part of the cost stack, so the comparison cannot be built until its structure is fixed
campaign timing is computed from the dates and confidence labels the census holds; without the census there is nothing to time
the notice window, not the last payment, is the operative date, and only the end-of-term mechanics establish where that window sits
the profile supplies the questions worth asking: what generates pages here, what seasonality to expect and what downtime costs this kind of operation
the roles, approvals and buying route are surfaced in discovery before they can be mapped and confirmed
discovery is where the evidence is requested and where the expectation is set that no configuration or rate precedes it
a payoff figure and a return exposure can only be understood against the end-of-term provisions of the agreement being displaced
shapes are chosen partly on what the honest total cost of each looks like to this customer over the same period
the packet documents a chosen shape; until the shape is selected there is nothing to write down
the volume basis or the labelled assumption with its true-up mechanism is a mandatory section of the packet and gates its issue
the handoff checks that the signed documents agree with the packet that was presented and that its term summary was acknowledged
the page rates and minimum commitment are one of the main places margin is taken, so the margin picture is incomplete until the service structure exists
the minimum disclosure set fixes the mandatory sections of the packet and the contents of the term summary the customer keeps
edges.risk_of_conflict: a packet built for brevity drops disclosures the doctrine requires

edges.why_related: the rollover line, its destination and its effect on the total of payments exist because the disclosure doctrine forbids material terms that are technically present and never explained
no offer shape may commit device count, capacity or minimum volume beyond what the evidenced volume supports, and none may undersize to reach a payment
authority verification, unhurried signing and invited independent review are conditions the handoff must evidence before an order passes
the comparison may only contain claims about the incumbent that the customer's own documents or a written quote support, which bounds what the stack can assert
drive retention, sanitization and swap restrictions change which shapes are viable and what a device exchange or return may cost
the funder's structure appetite, credit outcome and conditions bound the term, payment and guarantee language the packet may present
several legitimate margin sources — factor spread, term length, absorbed payoffs inside the amount financed — become far less lucrative the moment they are stated plainly to the customer
edges.resolution_rule: disclosure wins without exception: any margin source that cannot be stated aloud during the term-summary walkthrough is removed from the deal rather than concealed, and the price is held or the deal is lost

edges.why_related: quota timing pushes a mid-term account to close now through a rollover, while the account's own economics usually favour waiting for the notice window
edges.resolution_rule: run the wait-versus-roll arithmetic in front of the customer; if waiting costs them less, say so, diarise the notice window and take the scheduled campaign — a rollover proceeds only when the customer elects it in writing with the payoff line visible

edges.why_related: program tiers, fund conditions and line commitments pull toward placing the device that pays best, while the segment profile points at the device the account's pages and finishing actually need
edges.resolution_rule: fit dominates incentive: quote the configuration the evidenced workflow requires, and where no carried line fits, decline the placement or partner rather than force a mismatch to reach a tier

edges.why_related: the structures that produce the lowest visible monthly figure — a longer term, a low minimum with a high overage rate, an escalating page rate — are exactly the ones that raise the honest total
edges.resolution_rule: quote on total cost over the stated comparison period; a low-payment variant may be presented only alongside its own total of payments and total cost, never as the headline on its own

edges.why_related: the standard cure for a marginal credit is a personal guarantee or advance payments, which lands hardest on exactly the buyer least equipped to evaluate what they are signing
edges.resolution_rule: disclose any guarantee or condition in writing before submission and give the buyer time to take advice; if the buyer cannot restate the obligation in their own words, or the payment is out of proportion to evidenced volume, restructure smaller or decline the placement

edges.why_related: a larger device and a higher minimum commitment both improve the placement's economics, while the evidence usually justifies less of each
edges.resolution_rule: the evidence gate dominates: capacity or commitment above the evidenced volume may only appear as a separately priced option the customer expressly elects, never inside the recommended configuration

edges.why_related: a declining volume trajectory is what makes long terms and high minimum commitments risky, so the market picture directly drives the structure and term that may honestly be offered
an absorbed payoff consumes margin, which in turn creates the pressure to lengthen the term or raise the minimum to recover it
the confirmed buying route decides the packet's form and deadline — an informal quote, a bid response with mandatory sections, or a quote against an existing cooperative award
credit approval and every documented condition must be complete before the order may pass to deployment and a delivery date is promised
won and lost outcomes, the term actually signed and the incumbent's new end date flow back into the census so the territory calendar stays alive
what survives an honest total-cost comparison in front of real buyers teaches the dealer which structures can be priced and defended, and which only work in the dark
both are duty-of-care units in which the customer's own capacity or obligation, rather than the sale, sets the pace and the content of the conversation

conflict_axes.name: term_length_versus_volume_certainty
conflict_axes.description: A longer term lowers the visible payment and raises total financed value, but it bets several years of page volume in a market whose volumes drift downward and whose customers keep announcing workflow changes.
poles: longer term, lower visible payment
shorter term matched to the customer's own confidence in their volume
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: offer the term the account's evidenced volume direction and stated plans can carry, present the longer variant only with its total of payments beside it, and never lengthen a term to absorb a cost quietly

conflict_axes.name: low_monthly_payment_versus_total_cost_truth
conflict_axes.description: Buyers compare monthly figures, while the honest number is the total of payments plus service, consumables, end-of-term and any rollover over the same period.
poles: win the comparison on the monthly figure
win the decision on the total cost over an identical period
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: always show both, normalise the period and the volume, and label every assumption; if the deal can only be won on the monthly figure alone, it is a deal that will be disputed later

conflict_axes.name: capacity_headroom_versus_evidenced_volume
conflict_axes.description: Extra speed, finishing and a larger duty rating are easy to justify as headroom and pay better, while the meters usually justify less machine than the representative would like to place.
poles: configure for growth and comfort
configure to the documented volume and mix
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: recommend to the evidence and price headroom as an elected option with its own cost over the term, so the customer chooses the excess knowingly rather than inheriting it

conflict_axes.name: close_now_versus_wait_for_term_end
conflict_axes.description: A mid-term prospect can be closed immediately by absorbing or rolling the payoff, or scheduled to the notice window at real cost to this quarter's number.
poles: close the placement now through a rollover
schedule the account to its notice window
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: put the wait-versus-roll arithmetic in front of the customer with the payoff quote attached and let them choose in writing; the dealer's quota is not a fact about the customer's economics

conflict_axes.name: disclosure_completeness_versus_deal_momentum
conflict_axes.description: Every additional disclosed term slows the close and hands an advantage to a competitor who says less, particularly on small placements where the buyer wants it over quickly.
poles: keep the signing simple and short
walk the full minimum disclosure set before signature
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: hold the disclosure set constant regardless of deal size but improve its delivery — one plain page, read aloud, with a comprehension check — so completeness costs minutes rather than momentum

conflict_axes.name: carried_line_incentive_versus_segment_fit
conflict_axes.description: Program tiers, fund conditions and inventory pull toward the line that pays best, while the segment's page generator, finishing needs and uptime sensitivity point at what actually fits.
poles: place the best-incented line
place the configuration the workflow needs
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: let fit select the configuration and let the program decide only among configurations that fit; where nothing carried fits, decline or partner and record why

conflict_axes.name: bundled_simplicity_versus_unbundled_transparency
conflict_axes.description: One all-inclusive monthly figure is easier to sell and easier to hide things inside; a separated lease payment and page agreement is transparent but harder to present and leaves the customer with two documents and two invoices.
poles: bundle everything into a single payment
separate the finance and service commitments explicitly
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: bundling is permitted only where the components, their terms and their escalation are itemised in the term summary, so simplicity is a presentation choice rather than a place to conceal cost

conflict_axes.name: credit_cure_versus_buyer_protection
conflict_axes.description: A marginal credit is usually curable with a personal guarantee, advance payments or a shorter term, each of which shifts risk onto the buyer least able to evaluate it.
poles: cure the credit and place the equipment
protect an unadvised buyer from an obligation they do not grasp
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: disclose the cure in writing before submission, give time for advice, and decline or shrink the placement when the buyer cannot restate the obligation or the payment outruns evidenced volume

conflict_axes.name: return_data_handling_versus_cost_and_convenience
conflict_axes.description: Customers handling protected information may require drive retention, sanitization or documented destruction at removal, all of which add cost and complexity that competitors' quotes often omit entirely.
poles: keep the quote simple and competitive
price and document the removal obligation properly
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: surface the requirement in discovery, put the sanitization or retention expectation and its cost in the proposal and the signed documents, and let the customer's compliance owner set the standard rather than the sales cycle

conflict_axes.name: intelligence_maintenance_versus_selling_time
conflict_axes.description: Keeping dates, lessors and device records current produces no revenue this week, and the hours come directly out of appointments, so it is the first discipline dropped under quota pressure.
poles: spend the hours in front of customers
spend the hours keeping the territory calendar true
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: capture census facts inside the appointments themselves rather than as separate administrative work, and treat an unsourced or undated record as absent so nobody plans a campaign on it

edge_cases.description: The prospect's agreement has already renewed automatically because the notice window closed months before anyone looked, so the account a representative was told was expiring is locked for another period
edge_cases.trigger: an automatic renewal fires before the campaign begins
edge_cases.mitigation: read the actual document, confirm the renewed term and the next notice window in writing, tell the customer plainly what their real options now are including that waiting may be the cheapest one, re-diarise the account to the new window, and do not sell a rollover as an escape without showing the arithmetic

edge_cases.description: The customer's stated volume is far above what the meters show, and the whole configuration and page rate were being built on the belief
edge_cases.trigger: meter or invoice evidence contradicts self-reported volume
edge_cases.mitigation: quote to the evidence, show both the belief and the measurement in the proposal, set the minimum commitment at the evidenced level, and add a true-up mechanism rather than splitting the difference

edge_cases.description: The incumbent responds with a matching quote built on a different term, a different minimum commitment and different inclusions, so the two documents cannot be compared as they stand
edge_cases.trigger: a competing quote arrives on an incompatible basis
edge_cases.mitigation: normalise both onto the same period, volume, mix and inclusion set in one table, mark every unknown as unknown rather than estimating it in your own favour, and confine commentary to what the documents say

edge_cases.description: A public entity cannot obligate itself beyond the current fiscal period and the funder's standard documents do not contemplate that
edge_cases.trigger: a governmental lessee with appropriation limits
edge_cases.mitigation: route to a funder whose documents support a non-appropriation provision, obtain the entity's authorizing action before delivery, verify current requirements with the entity's purchasing office and your funder, and never advise the entity about its own legal authority

edge_cases.description: A personal guarantee appears in the funder's approval conditions and reaches the signing table without the owner having been told it was likely
edge_cases.trigger: a conditional credit approval requiring a guarantee
edge_cases.mitigation: stop the signing, disclose the guarantee in writing with a plain explanation of what it commits, give the owner time to take advice, and restructure or withdraw rather than obtain a signature under time pressure

edge_cases.description: The customer's compliance owner appears late in the cycle and requires that device storage never leave the premises, after the configuration and price were already agreed
edge_cases.trigger: a stored-data or records-disposal requirement surfaces after the proposal
edge_cases.mitigation: reprice the removal path openly rather than absorbing it silently, write the retention or sanitization expectation and its cost into the documents, and add the question to the discovery script so the next account raises it early

edge_cases.description: A seasonal account concentrates most of its annual volume into a few months, so a flat monthly minimum overcharges it for half the year
edge_cases.trigger: an academic, tax-season or closing-cycle volume pattern
edge_cases.mitigation: annualise the evidenced volume, set the commitment on an annual or quarterly reconciliation basis where the agreement allows it, and state in plain language exactly how unused pages are treated

edge_cases.description: The customer wants finishing or colour capability they will rarely use, and the larger configuration happens to carry better economics for the dealer
edge_cases.trigger: a requested capability that the evidenced volume does not justify
edge_cases.mitigation: quote the evidence-justified base configuration as the recommendation and the requested capability as a separately priced option with its own cost across the term, so the election is explicit and recorded

edge_cases.description: The account is acquired, merges or closes a location partway through the term and the equipment must move, be reassigned or be terminated
edge_cases.trigger: a mid-term corporate or premises change
edge_cases.mitigation: disclose relocation, assignment and early-termination provisions at sale time so the customer knows the position in advance, and at the time of the event obtain the funder's written position before promising any outcome

edge_cases.description: A customer asks the representative directly whether they should sign, or how the lease will look on their books and taxes
edge_cases.trigger: a request for financial, tax or legal advice from the seller
edge_cases.mitigation: supply the mechanism and the numbers in writing, decline to give accounting, tax or legal advice, encourage review by the customer's own advisor, and record the referral in the file

edge_cases.description: A contact offers the incumbent's confidential pricing sheet, obtained from a departing employee, to help the dealer undercut it
edge_cases.trigger: confidential competitor material offered by a contact
edge_cases.mitigation: decline to accept or use the material, work instead from documents the customer owns such as their own invoices and agreement, record the refusal, and build the comparison from the customer's own data

workflow.action: Fix the segments the team will actually sell into and why
workflow.description: Convert the market's volume direction into a target list built on page generators rather than on segment folklore, and record what drives each segment's pages, its seasonality, its uptime sensitivity and its buying route
workflow.artifact: segment target list with page generators, seasonality, uptime sensitivity and buying routes
workflow.gate: every targeted segment names its page generator, its seasonality, its uptime sensitivity and its buying route, and no account is configured from the profile alone

workflow.action: Adopt the disclosure standard before any selling activity begins
workflow.description: Build the plain-language term summary template and the disclosure checklist that every proposal and signing will use regardless of deal size
workflow.artifact: term summary template and disclosure checklist
workflow.gate: the template covers payments and frequency, inclusions, minimum and overage, escalation, lessor identity and the unconditional payment obligation, end-of-term options, notice window and delivery method, return obligations, guarantee and pass-throughs

workflow.action: Build and maintain the territory census
workflow.description: Record per account the incumbent, the lessor, device classes and ages, the contract end date, the notice deadline and what the customer believes, each with its source, capture date and confidence
workflow.artifact: territory account register with sourced, dated and confidence-labelled records
workflow.gate: contract end date and notice deadline are stored as separate fields, every date carries a source and confidence, and no campaign is scheduled from an unsourced date

workflow.action: Diary campaigns to the contract and approval calendars
workflow.description: Work backwards from each documented notice window, and for public entities from the budget and board calendar, to a campaign start date that leaves room for a valid notice and a considered decision
workflow.artifact: rolling expiration and notice calendar with campaign start dates
workflow.gate: each campaign start date derives from a documented notice window or is explicitly flagged as an estimate to confirm, and public-sector entries carry budget and board dates

workflow.action: Run structured discovery in the account
workflow.description: Establish documents produced, current pain, existing devices, planned workflow changes, the decision unit and the customer's own understanding of their agreement, and set the expectation that evidence precedes any configuration or rate
workflow.artifact: written discovery record separating what was reported from what was observed
workflow.gate: the record covers documents, pains, device inventory, planned changes, decision unit and the customer's stated understanding of their existing agreement

workflow.action: Map the decision unit and confirm the buying route
workflow.description: Identify each role and its objection, and for public and institutional buyers confirm the applicable route, thresholds, approval dates and any registration prerequisites with the entity's purchasing office
workflow.artifact: decision map with confirmed route, approval dates and prerequisites
workflow.gate: the route is confirmed with the entity's purchasing or finance owner and its source recorded, rather than assumed from a neighbouring entity

workflow.action: Obtain volume evidence and pass the evidence gate
workflow.description: Collect meters, usage reports, supply history or incumbent invoices covering a period long enough to expose seasonality, or write the labelled assumption and its true-up mechanism where evidence genuinely cannot be obtained
workflow.artifact: volume basis sheet stating the evidence, its period and any labelled assumption
workflow.gate: no configuration, minimum commitment or page rate is drafted until documented evidence or a labelled assumption with a true-up mechanism exists, and the evidence period covers known seasonality

workflow.action: Select the offer shape and the commercial structure
workflow.description: Choose among a fleet-wide page agreement, a lease with a separate service agreement, a purchase with maintenance, a short-term placement or a seat-based construct, on volume durability, device mix, procurement route, technology capacity and budget treatment
workflow.artifact: offer shape decision with written rationale and the add-or-remove mechanism where flexibility is needed
workflow.gate: the selected shape is justified against the account's constraints rather than by habit or incentive, and any needed flexibility mechanism and its cost are stated

workflow.action: Build the like-for-like total cost view, including any rollover
workflow.description: Assemble the cost stack over a stated period at the customer's documented volume and mix, normalise any competing quote onto the same basis, and where the prospect is mid-term include the written payoff as its own visible line
workflow.artifact: total cost comparison with every assumption labelled and any rollover line shown
workflow.gate: both sides cover the same period, volume, mix and inclusions, every figure traces to data, a written quote or a labelled assumption, and no unknowable amount appears as a bare number

workflow.action: Issue the proposal packet and the term summary
workflow.description: Assemble the mandated sections, walk the term summary through with the customer out loud, and check comprehension of the end-of-term obligation before asking for a decision
workflow.artifact: proposal packet plus the acknowledged one-page term summary the customer keeps
workflow.gate: every mandated section is present, each number is traceable, the notice window and delivery method are stated in plain language, and the response commitments match what the service organisation can staff

workflow.action: Run the credit path with conditions disclosed in advance
workflow.description: Select the funder, assemble the submission, tell the customer in writing what will be requested and whether a guarantee or advance payments are likely, and handle any decline or counter-offer as a choice rather than a surprise
workflow.artifact: funder submission record with written pre-submission disclosures and the current written quote used
workflow.gate: any guarantee or condition was disclosed in writing before submission, and public-entity files carry the non-appropriation provision and the authorizing action

workflow.action: Close, verify and hand off the order
workflow.description: Verify signing authority, check cross-document consistency, attach the volume basis and disclosures, record the customer's notice obligation to the outgoing lessor with dates and an owner, and capture the site facts deployment will need
workflow.artifact: complete order packet ready for the deployment team
workflow.gate: all eight definition-of-done conditions are evidenced in the file and a reviewer other than the selling representative has confirmed cross-document consistency

priority_rationale: The market and conduct frames come first because nothing downstream is safe without them: the volume picture and the segment profiles decide who is worth selling to, and the disclosure doctrine, buyer-care duty and competitive-conduct rules bound every later choice about how an offer may be built and presented. Instrument literacy follows, because the lease structure, the credit path, the end-of-term mechanics and the page-agreement terms are the raw material of every proposal and of every honest total-cost comparison. The pipeline units then run in the order the work actually has to happen — census, campaign timing, discovery, decision route, evidence gate — because each one prevents rework in the next, and the evidence gate in particular must close before any configuration or rate exists. Offer construction sits late because a shape, a cost frame, a rollover disclosure and a packet can only be assembled once the evidence, the route and the instrument are settled, and the signed-order handoff sits last because it is the inspectable boundary at which this knowledge base ends and deployment begins.

dominance_rules.rationale: this vertical's reputational damage comes almost entirely from material terms that were present in the document and never explained, and a lost deal costs far less than a disclosed-too-late dispute
dominance_rules.trigger: a material term is unexplained, the term summary has not been walked through, or the customer cannot restate the end-of-term obligation
dominance_rules.action: stop the close, disclose in writing and out loud, confirm comprehension, and accept the delay or the loss

dominance_rules.rule: Evidenced volume dominates configuration, minimum commitments and page rates
dominance_rules.rationale: capacity and commitments that the meters do not support produce either an overpriced placement or overage invoices, and both destroy the annuity the business depends on
dominance_rules.trigger: a proposed device class, device count or minimum commitment sits above or below the documented evidence
dominance_rules.action: requote to the evidence, and offer any excess capability only as a separately priced option the customer expressly elects

dominance_rules.rule: The customer's own documents dominate anyone's recollection
dominance_rules.rationale: end dates, notice windows, rates and inclusions recalled from memory are wrong often enough that acting on them mistimes campaigns and creates promises the paperwork contradicts
dominance_rules.trigger: a stated date, rate or inclusion conflicts with the agreement or invoice in front of you
dominance_rules.action: work from the document, correct the census, and re-time the campaign to the documented dates

dominance_rules.rule: Total-cost truth dominates the lowest visible monthly payment
dominance_rules.rationale: every mechanism that lowers a monthly figure — a longer term, a smaller minimum with a higher overage, an absorbed payoff — moves cost rather than removing it
dominance_rules.trigger: a structure is chosen or presented because it produces the most attractive monthly number
dominance_rules.action: present the total of payments and the total cost over the same period alongside it, and let the customer choose with both visible

dominance_rules.rationale: an obligation an unadvised buyer does not understand is a complaint, a rescission attempt or a bad review waiting for the first surprise invoice
dominance_rules.trigger: the buyer has no procurement or advisory support, a guarantee is being requested, or the payment is out of proportion to evidenced volume
dominance_rules.action: slow down, deliver the summary before the signing session, invite independent review, and restructure smaller or decline rather than press

dominance_rules.rule: Verifiable fact dominates every competitive claim
dominance_rules.rationale: an unevidenced claim about an incumbent becomes a promise the dealer must live with, and in a small territory it returns to the customer who heard it
dominance_rules.trigger: any assertion about a competitor's equipment, company, contract or pricing, or any urgency or compliance-risk statement
dominance_rules.action: state only what a document supports, put corrections in writing, and drop the claim if no document supports it

dominance_rules.rule: Segment fit dominates carried-line incentive and program tier
dominance_rules.rationale: a device that does not match the account's pages, finishing or uptime need generates service cost, disputes and an early exit that outlast any tier benefit
dominance_rules.trigger: the best-incented configuration is not the configuration the evidence and workflow require
dominance_rules.action: quote the fitting configuration, and where nothing carried fits, decline or partner and record the reason

dominance_rules.rule: Written quotes dominate every verbal number
dominance_rules.rationale: factors, program costs, page rates and payoff figures are deal-specific, funder-specific and time-limited, and a remembered number becomes a commitment the moment it is said
dominance_rules.trigger: a payment, factor, page rate or payoff amount is about to be communicated to a customer
dominance_rules.action: communicate only figures traceable to a current written quote and state the quote's date and expiry

dominance_rules.rule: Jurisdictional obligation classes dominate sales convenience
dominance_rules.rationale: procurement, data-protection and confidentiality requirements vary by jurisdiction and entity and change, and a confident wrong answer can void a transaction or create an exposure for the customer
dominance_rules.trigger: a public procurement, stored-data, records-disposal or confidentiality question arises
dominance_rules.action: name the obligation class, route verification to the entity's purchasing office, compliance owner or counsel, and never present a device feature or certificate as legal compliance

dominance_rules.rule: The handoff definition of done dominates a signature
dominance_rules.rationale: inconsistent documents and unassigned notice obligations are the two post-signature failures that cost the most to unwind and that customers remember longest
dominance_rules.trigger: an order is signed but a definition-of-done condition is unevidenced
dominance_rules.action: hold the order out of deployment until every condition is evidenced and an independent reviewer has confirmed document consistency

anti_rework_rules.rule: Read the prospect's existing agreement before diarising the campaign
anti_rework_rules.prevents: campaigns timed from a remembered date that arrive after the notice window has closed and leave a rollover as the only available deal

anti_rework_rules.rule: Obtain volume evidence before configuring a device or quoting any page rate
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a full requote when the meters contradict the estimate, and the overage disputes that follow a commitment set on a guess

anti_rework_rules.rule: Confirm the buying route and its calendar before building the packet
anti_rework_rules.prevents: rebuilding a private-format proposal as a formal bid response, or an award that has to be unwound because the route was wrong

anti_rework_rules.rule: Disclose any guarantee, advance payment or credit condition before the application is submitted
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a collapsed or re-papered deal at the signing table when the condition surfaces in front of the customer for the first time

anti_rework_rules.rule: Get the incumbent payoff in writing before promising anything about switching
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a rollover priced from an estimate that erases the margin, moves the payment after commitment, or breaks a promise the customer relied on

anti_rework_rules.rule: Raise stored data, sanitization and drive retention in discovery rather than at removal
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a last-minute compliance requirement that reprices the end-of-term path or halts a delivery already scheduled

anti_rework_rules.rule: Verify signing authority before final documents are produced
anti_rework_rules.prevents: documents signed by someone without authority, a funder rejection, and an authorizing action chased after delivery was promised

anti_rework_rules.rule: Settle the black and colour mix and the inclusion list before quoting page rates
anti_rework_rules.prevents: rebuilding the service structure when colour turns out to be a large share of the volume, and arguing later about imaging units, staples and waste containers

anti_rework_rules.rule: Capture site, access and network facts while the customer is still in the room at signature
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a delivery that meets a stairwell, a locked network closet or no agreed scan destination, and a second discovery visit by the deployment team

anti_rework_rules.rule: Record every census fact with its source, capture date and confidence at the moment it is learned
anti_rework_rules.prevents: rediscovering the same account from nothing after a representative leaves, and firing campaigns at dates nobody can trace

iteration_protocol.trigger: meter, invoice or supply evidence arrives that contradicts the volume basis a proposal was built on
iteration_protocol.action: requote the configuration, the minimum commitment and the page rates to the evidence, rebuild the total-cost view and reissue the packet with both the belief and the measurement shown

iteration_protocol.trigger: the prospect produces their actual agreement and its dates or terms differ from the census record
iteration_protocol.action: correct the census with the document as source, re-time the campaign to the documented notice window, and re-run the wait-versus-roll arithmetic if the account is mid-term

iteration_protocol.trigger: the funder returns a decline or a conditional approval carrying a guarantee, advance payments or a shortened term
iteration_protocol.action: disclose every condition in writing, rework the structure or shrink the placement, re-check proportionality for an unadvised buyer, and present the counter-offer as a choice rather than a formality

iteration_protocol.trigger: a complaint or dispute traces to a term the customer says was never explained
iteration_protocol.action: audit which disclosure step failed, repair the term summary template and the packet section that allowed it, and re-walk the standard with the team before the next cycle of proposals

iteration_protocol.trigger: a manufacturer, master dealer or funder changes program terms, cost positions, factors or documentation requirements
iteration_protocol.action: refresh the mechanism briefing, requote every open proposal from current written quotes, and re-examine which structures can still be offered honestly

iteration_protocol.trigger: a segment's page volumes or workflows shift at scale, for example an electronic-filing mandate, a records-system migration wave or a district device policy
iteration_protocol.action: update the segment profile and its page generators, re-rank the target list, and revisit the term lengths and minimum commitments offered into that segment

iteration_protocol.trigger: an account is lost to an incumbent or a competitor
iteration_protocol.action: record the outcome, the term signed and the next notice window in the census, re-diarise the account, and review whether the loss turned on timing, on cost framing or on a disclosure that was delivered badly rather than on price

iteration_protocol.trigger: a public entity changes its thresholds, cooperative vehicles, registration prerequisites or board and budget calendar
iteration_protocol.action: re-verify the route with the purchasing office, re-time the campaign and rebuild the packet in the required form

iteration_protocol.trigger: a customer's compliance owner raises a stored-data, retention or disposal requirement the current process does not cover
iteration_protocol.action: capture it in the segment requirements, price the removal path openly in the proposal, add the question to the discovery script, and reflect the expectation in the signed documents
